SUCCESS IN LAW is for anyone who wants to follow a self-study course. Whatever your reasons for study - personal or vocational - you will also find that the book covers core syllabus requirements for the following examinations: BEC National Certificate and Diploma; BEC Higher National; GCE O and A level; RSA; and examinations set by the appropriate institutions for Banking, Accountancy, Marketing, Export, Transport, and Legal Executives. The book is recommended to any student following a course of which law is an option, and to those who are preparing for degree-level work. It provides, in readable narrative style, a basic study of the general principles of English law and shows their practical applications to everyday life and business.
